title: Winemaker's Table
line: A private tasting of the house's current and library releases, hosted by the winemaker.
description: An afternoon at the house, in the company of the winemaker. A walk through the current cuvées, a conversation about the vintage, and — if the weather holds — the method demonstrated quietly, from riddling to disgorgement.
includes: Two bottles of Sparkling Brut per ten guests
A guided tasting of the current Grande Cuvée releases
A short tour of the disgorgement room
Optional saber lesson for one or two of the party
practical: Held on the estate in North Saanich
Outdoor, weather permitting; indoor alternative is reserved
Scheduling confirmed by email within seventy-two hours

title: An Ocean-Aged Evening
line: A seated vertical of the Ocean Aged release, offered only in the months around retrieval.
description: A rare format, offered once or twice a year when the Ocean Aged bottles are lifted from the sea. A formal, seated tasting of the land-aged and sea-aged expressions side by side, with supper drawn from the peninsula.
includes: A flight of Grande Cuvée paired against the Ocean Aged release
A short course supper by a peninsula chef
A signed record of the evening
practical: Dates set with the tide, not the calendar
